title: NewL1 compute worker request (protocol v1)
description: Request file passed to the worker CLI: newl1-bench --request <request.json> --output <samples.jsonl>. One request drives one fresh worker process for one session; the worker reconstructs the full baseline per requested sample and flushes one JSONL result per terminal outcome. Mode/phase applicability: diagnostic-phase samples only run in diagnostic mode (inspector-bearing EVM); pilot, warmup, and qualification samples only run in performance mode (uninstrumented production executor). The Go validator in pkg/compute/protocol.go additionally enforces unique sample_id values and, via ValidateAgainst, that every case_id exists in the referenced workload.
